found.name: Artificial Intelligence LibGuide
found.quote: This guide offers practical information on responsible AI use in academic contexts, including institutional policies, ethical frameworks, and best practice tips for working with AI tools.
You'll find sections covering prompt engineering techniques, a curated list of AI platforms for academic use
The library provides guidance on how to correctly cite and reference Generative AI in this guide as well as in each of the citation style guides available on our website.
